notes.title: Development Is Still In Progress
notes.content:
Feedback And Discussions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42691739/5c0470795e03e82d7b3c1f9fa7433d90877c4a89.png

I Am Hosting An "Ask Me Anything" and A "Help Desk" Session On My Discord Server. Here I Would Like To Know About Your Experiences With My Game, As I Am Still Developing And Learning New Problems Daily （＾∀＾●）ﾉｼ. I Understand Some Users Are Experiencing Things That I Didn't Expect, Many Things That Were Not Prevalent To Me or My PC During My Playtesting. Which Is Why I Wanted To Upload This Demo. As A Solo Dev I Am Curious As To See What These Issues Are, And Hope I Can Fix Them Or Understand Them For Future Builds Of This Game. This Of Course Is A Passion Project, And I Am Willing To Work On Things Until The End.
